description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Phantasmal Image enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Phantasmal Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Phantasmal Image from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.
